sqlMap.select:
SELECT RI.REC_INTERVIEW_NO, RA.REC_AFFIRM_NO, RE.EMP_NAME, RE.REC_EMPLOYEE_NO, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(RE.FINAL_EDU_CODE,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#)FINAL_EDU, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(RE.POST_TYPE_CODE,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#)POST_TYPE, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(RE.SEX_CODE,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#)SEX, FLOOR(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, TO_DATE(RE.EMP_BIRTHDAY,'YYYY/MM/DD'))/ 12)AGE, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(RE.NATIONALITY_CODE,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#)NATIONALITY_CODE, RE.EMP_TELPHONE, RI.INTERVIEW_STATUS, RA.SCORE, RA.AFFIRM_FLAG, RA.AFFIRM_REMARK FROM REC_INTERVIEW RI,REC_EMPLOYEE RE,REC_AFFIRM RA WHERE RI.REC_EMPLOYEE_NO = RE.REC_EMPLOYEE_NO AND RI.REC_INTERVIEW_NO = RA.REC_INTERVIEW_NO AND RA.AFFIRMOR_ID = #adminId:VARCHAR#
UPPER(RE.EMP_NAME) LIKE UPPER('%'||#EMP_NAME:VARCHAR#||'%')
RE.POST_TYPE_CODE = #POST_TYPE_CODE:VARCHAR#
RE.FINAL_EDU_CODE = #FINAL_EDU:VARCHAR#
RI.INTERVIEW_STATUS = #INTER_STATUS:NUMRIC# AND RI.REC_INTERVIEW_NO IN( SELECT RECA.REC_INTERVIEW_NO FROM REC_AFFIRM RECA WHERE RECA.AFFIRMOR_ID = #adminId:VARCHAR# GROUP BY RECA.REC_INTERVIEW_NO )
RA.REC_AFFIRM_NO IN( SELECT RAT.REC_AFFIRM_NO FROM REC_AFFIRM RAT WHERE RAT.AFFIRMOR_ID = #adminId:VARCHAR# AND RAT.AFFIRM_FLAG = 0)
ORDER BY RI.REC_INTERVIEW_NO DESC

SELECT HRE.EMPID, HRE.LOCAL_NAME, GET_DEPT_NAME(HRE.DEPTNO,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#)DEPTNAME, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(HRE.POST_GRADE_NO,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#)POSTGRADENAME, RA.AFFIRM_FLAG, RA.SCORE, RA.AFFIRM_REMARK FROM REC_AFFIRM RA,HR_EMPLOYEE HRE, REC_INTERVIEW RE WHERE RA.AFFIRMOR_ID = HRE.PERSON_ID AND RA.REC_INTERVIEW_NO = RE.REC_INTERVIEW_NO
RA.REC_INTERVIEW_NO = #REC_INTERVIEW_NO:VARCHAR#
RE.REC_EMPLOYEE_NO = #REC_EMPLOYEE_NO:VARCHAR#
ORDER BY RA.AFFIRM_LEVEL
sqlMap.update: UPDATE REC_AFFIRM SET AFFIRM_FLAG = #affirmFlag:VARCHAR#, AFFIRM_REMARK = #AFFIRM_REMARK:VARCHAR#, SCORE = #SCORE:VARCHAR#, UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE, UPDATED_BY = #createBy:VARCHAR# WHERE REC_AFFIRM_NO = #REC_AFFIRM_NO:VARCHAR#
sqlMap.select: SELECT 1 FROM REC_AFFIRM RA WHERE RA.AFFIRMOR_ID = #adminID:VARCHAR# AND AFFIRM_FLAG <> 0 AND RA.REC_INTERVIEW_NO = #REC_INTERVIEW_NO:VARCHAR# AND RA.AFFIRM_LEVEL = (SELECT MAX(AFFIRM_LEVEL) FROM REC_INTERVIEW RI, REC_AFFIRM RECA WHERE RI.REC_INTERVIEW_NO = RECA.REC_INTERVIEW_NO AND RI.INTERVIEW_STATUS = 0 AND RI.REC_INTERVIEW_NO = #REC_INTERVIEW_NO:VARCHAR# AND RI.ACTIVITY = 1)
sqlMap.update: UPDATE REC_INTERVIEW SET INTERVIEW_STATUS = #affirmFlag:VARCHAR#, UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE, UPDATED_BY = #createBy:VARCHAR# WHERE REC_INTERVIEW_NO = #REC_INTERVIEW_NO:VARCHAR#
